vulnerability.name: Roxy-WI
vulnerability.author: Harry J. Hall
Tom Shaw
vulnerability.description: This module installs a vulnerable version of Roxy-WI, a web interface for managing HAProxy, Nginx, Apache and Keepalived servers. Roxy-WI before 6.1.1.0 is affected by an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2022-31137). The application exposes several Python CGI endpoints; in app/options.py the values of the request parameters serv, ipserv and ipbackend are concatenated into a shell command string that is run with subprocess shell=True, without adequate sanitisation. An unauthenticated attacker can therefore inject arbitrary operating-system commands which run under the context of the web-server user (www-data).
vulnerability.hint: A web interface for managing HAProxy, served over HTTPS, trusts request parameters it should not.
vulnerability.solution: Roxy-WI before 6.1.1.0 passes request parameters into a shell command (CVE-2022-31137); inject an OS command to gain code execution as www-data.
